acceptance: Red first: a stub systemd-run that fails as a busless host does. attach then creates the session bare, with labels. run then creates it with labels. A failure of the user's explicit ZMX_LAUNCHER stays visible rather than being swallowed. No failure mode leaves a dotted session unlabelled at exit 0. The usability check adds no external command to the hot path if a shell test can answer it.
title: Fall back when the launcher is unusable
